home.title: Characters, skills and gear in one place
home.lede: A MONGIL: STAR DIVE database — characters with all four skills and six Awaken stages, artifacts, equipment, monsterlings, food and build guides. Fast to search and filter, and built for phones.
home.statusBody: The site shell, deployment, term dictionary and damage formula are in place. Next up is entering real character data — the full plan lives in docs/PLAN.md in the repository.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.lede: Every gear set, with its set bonuses and the pieces that make it up
equipment.rolledNote: Substats are rolled when the item drops, so they belong to no item definition and are not stored here
equipment.mainStatNote: The main stat is fixed by slot and grade, not rolled — the crafting screen lists one option at 100%. Values shown are at max level. Only the substats are rolled when the item drops, so they are not stored here.
equipment.substatNote: Substats are rolled when the item drops. Each option has five value tiers whose odds are always 50 / 30 / 14 / 5 / 1 percent of that option's chance. Both grades offer the same eleven options at the same chances — only the values differ. Values are at level 1; whether they grow with level is not known yet.
